lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karatiaa nihaphal janam gavaaiaa sukhadaataa man na vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Involved in worldly affairs, he wastes his life in vain; the peace-giving Lord does not come to abide in his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinaa kau miliaa jin kau dhur likh paaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Name, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee mahi a(n)mrit bharapoor hai manamukhaa saad na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The home within is filled with Ambrosial Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not get to taste it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਦਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu kasatooree mirag na jaanai bhramadaa bharam bhulaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is like the deer, who does not recognize its own musk-scent; it wanders around, deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit taj bikh sa(n)grahai karatai aap khuaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The manmukh forsakes the Ambrosial Nectar, and instead gathers poison; the Creator Himself has fooled him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਤਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh virale sojhee paee tinaa a(n)dar braham dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: How rare are the Gurmukhs, who obtain this understanding; they behold the Lord God within themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man seetal hoiaa rasanaa har saad aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed, and their tongues enjoy the sublime taste of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade hee naau oopajai sabade mel milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Name wells up; through the Shabad, we are united in the Lord's Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai sabh jag bauraanaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, the whole world is insane, and it loses its life in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit eko sabad hai naanak guramukh paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Shabad alone is Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: so har purakh aga(n)m hai kahu kit bidh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord God is inaccessible; tell me, how can we find Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis roop na rekh adrisat kahu jan kiu dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: He has no form or feature, and He cannot be seen; tell me, how can we meditate on Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: nira(n)kaar nira(n)jan har agam kiaa kahi gun gaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is formless, immaculate and inaccessible; which of His Virtues should we speak of and sing?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaae aap s har maarag paaeeai ||
lines.translation: They alone walk on the Lord's Path, whom the Lord Himself instructs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai vekhaaliaa gur sevaa paaeeai ||4||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has revealed Him to me; serving the Guru, He is found. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਭੋਰੀ ਡੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu tan koloo peeReeai rat na bhoree dehi ||
lines.translation: It is as if my body has been crushed in the oil-press, without yielding even a drop of blood;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu va(n)njai chau kha(n)neeai sache sa(n)daRai nehi ||
lines.translation: it is as if my soul has been cut apart into pieces for the sake of the Love of the True Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mel na chukaee raatee atai deh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, still, night and day, my Union with the Lord is not broken. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan maidaa ra(n)gulaa ra(n)g laae man lei ||
lines.translation: My Friend is so full of joy and love; He colors my mind with the color of His Love,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਜੀਠੈ ਕਪੜੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਭੀ ਪਾਹੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu maajeethai kapaRe ra(n)ge bhee paahehi ||
lines.translation: like the fabric which is treated to retain the color of the dye.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੇਹ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ra(n)g na utarai biaa na lagai keh ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this color does not depart, and no other color can be imparted to this fabric. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aap varatai aap har aap bulaaidaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is pervading everywhere; the Lord Himself causes us to chant His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape srisat savaar sir dha(n)dhai laaidaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself created the creation; He commits all to their tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa bhagatee laai ik aap khuaaidaa ||
lines.translation: He engages some in devotional worship, and others, He causes to stray.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa maarag paai ik ujhaR paaidaa ||
lines.translation: He places some on the Path, while He leads others into the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaae guramukh gun gaaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa saphal hai je ko kare chit laai ||
lines.translation: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding, if one performs it with his mind focused on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paavanaa haumai vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, and egotism departs from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRai mukat hoi sache rahai samaai ||
lines.translation: His bonds are broken, and he is liberated; he remains absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jag mahi naam alabh hai guramukh vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam in this world; it comes to dwell in the mind of the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo gur sevahi aapanaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to one who serves his True Guru. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੰਨੁ ਅਜਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ma(n)n ajit hai doojai lagai jaai ||
lines.translation: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is so very stubborn; it is stuck in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis no sukh supanai nahee dukhe dukh vihaai ||
lines.translation: He does not find peace, even in dreams; he passes his life in misery and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਥਕੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar paR paR pa(n)dit thake sidh samaadh lagaai ||
lines.translation: The Pandits have grown weary of going door to door, reading and reciting their scriptures; the Siddhas have gone into their trances of Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man vas na aavaee thake karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: This mind cannot be controlled; they are tired of performing religious rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhekhadhaaree bhekh kar thake athisath teerath naai ||
lines.translation: The impersonators have grown weary of wearing false costumes, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines.
